name: Raven Poof Intro
description: An intro for your video: your figurine or object bursts into a flock of ravens that fly off, then your title appears over the empty shelf. The clip is matched to your photo's exposure, with a whoosh on the burst. 9:16.

photo.label: A photo of a figurine or object on a shelf or table

license: Apache-2.0 weights (Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B); exposure match, title and whoosh by FreeField

fixed.motion_prompt.text: In a sudden burst it becomes a flock of black ravens that fly up and out of the frame, and only the empty shelf remains. Smooth, natural motion. Static shot: the camera holds steady and the background stays still.
